title: Car Fuel Economy
description: An introductory R report explores the mtcars dataset with descriptive summaries and a histogram of fuel economy.

title: Daily Activity, Attention & Heart Rates
methods: Data Import, Visualization & Mixed File Formats
description: Explore daily dog-walking activity, then work with attention and heart-rate data imported from text and spreadsheet files.

title: Baseball Players & Lake Acidity
description: Investigate baseball-player weights and lake acidity using numerical summaries, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests.

title: Copper in Flour & Sunspot Activity
description: Examine copper measurements in wholemeal flour and sunspot counts, with attention to distributional shape and the assumptions behind inference.

title: Designing an Experiment with Enough Power
description: Compare simulated and theoretical test power, explore how sample size changes detection rates, and plan a treatment-control experiment.

title: Quality Control in Shrimp Cocktails
methods: Sign Tests & Confidence Intervals for a Median
description: Assess whether shrimp content is consistent with a production target, using a normality check and methods robust to outliers.

title: Irish Wind Speeds & Blood Coagulation
description: Compare wind measurements recorded on matching days and investigate differences in coagulation times across diets.

title: Crab Species & Natural Gas Demand
description: Reshape crab measurements into analysis-ready tables and examine a regression model for natural gas consumption.

title: Rocket Thrust & Concrete Setting
description: Explore how rocket thrust efficiency varies with angle and model concrete-setting measurements, checking departures from a straight-line relationship.

title: Household Income & Petition Signatures
description: Estimate population quantities from samples, including household income and petition signatures, and explore inclusion probabilities and systematic sampling.

title: Workplace Wellness & Timber Resources
description: Allocate a wellness survey across departments, estimate roadside timber volume, and compare sampling designs and required sample sizes.

title: Schools, Household Energy & Influenza Risk
methods: Ratio Estimation, Regression Estimation & Risk Measures
description: Explore estimator bias using school data, estimate household electricity use with an auxiliary variable, and assess the association between vaccination and influenza.

title: Lawn Compaction & Seed Germination
description: Investigate the relationship between lawn-roller weight and compaction, then model germination outcomes for parasitic-plant seeds.

title: Chicago Voting Patterns & Halifax Snowfall
description: Relate precinct voting outcomes to voter composition in Chicago and examine categorical weather outcomes in Halifax.

title: Remission in Acute Myeloid Leukemia
description: Compare remission duration under maintenance and no-maintenance treatment in a small teaching dataset, accounting for censored observations.

title: Onion Density & Wheat Field Variation
description: Study onion yields across planting densities and locations, and investigate spatial variation in wheat grain and straw. The report also uses planned contrasts for age-group differences in fact-versus-opinion scores.

title: Self-Esteem over Time & Rainforest Leaves
methods: Repeated Measures, Mixed Models & Discriminant Analysis
description: Analyze repeated self-esteem measurements and investigate whether leaf-shape measurements distinguish rainforest groups.

title: Patterns Among Exoplanets & Species
methods: K-Means Clustering, Hierarchical Methods & Cluster Stability
description: Group exoplanets by standardized physical features, explore alternative cluster counts with a custom function, and compare cluster membership. A second analysis examines genetic distances among vertebrate species.

title: Ice Hockey Fantasy Draft
methods: String Parsing, Scoring Rules & Budget Constraints
description: Build the decision logic for a fantasy hockey draft: interpret compact player statistics, calculate fantasy scores, and determine whether a selection fits roster and budget constraints.

title: Messages Hidden in Matrices
methods: Nested Lists, Matrix Transformations & Phrase Decoding
description: Explore a phrase-encoding system built around binary character matrices. The implementation validates matrix structure, combines and transforms rows, and supports rotation, reflection and phrase reconstruction.

title: Social Networks & Suspicious Account Patterns
methods: CSV Processing, Dictionaries, Quantiles & Network Heuristics
description: Analyze social-media account records and follower relationships. The implementation builds nested account dictionaries, measures mutual connections, and uses activity and network heuristics to flag and rank candidate accounts for further review.

title: Personal Finance Ledger
description: Develop a menu-driven accounting application that records income and expenses, stores transactions in SQLite, and produces category summaries and time-based reports. The project connects basic database operations with personal financial analysis.

title: NYSE Composite Market Trends & Data Quality
methods: Python Time-Series EDA, Data Cleaning & Correlation Analysis
description: Explore historical NYSE Composite (NYA) market data through missing-value diagnostics, date preparation, price distributions, time-series views and correlations between price measures.
